control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at SG-8000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on SG-8000 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-8000 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-8000 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. SG-8000 (station switchgear) is in service for station HV distribution. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 1 March 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on SG-8000 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during a statutory inspection; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
